title: BetterOmnis
about: Buffs to Omnicell passives (Bastion, Iceborne, Discipline, Tempest, Revenant, plus a new Revenant passive, Blood Ward); actives unchanged, the disc shows the new numbers. Needs Lantern Client running and its mod (DFTrainer) on. Switches with the game fully closed. Full effect only in hunts you host.
